mentions.name: Weather-based outdoor activity planner (yet-unnamed)
mentions.description: A yet-unnamed, unreleased weather app for planning outdoor activities at times of the day when the weather will be most favorable (or least bad).
mentions.problem: Tough winter weather in the Northeastern US makes it hard to know when to plan outdoor tasks, such as bringing in firewood for the stove.
mentions.audience: The author planning backyard chores and other outdoor activities around the weather
mentions.source_excerpt: 2. Yet-unnamed and -unreleased weather app for planning outdoor activities at times of the day when the weather will be most favorable (or least bad). Made it so that I can plan when to go out to the back yard to bring in more fire wood for the stove in my house.
